SELECT a.AUC_SN AS auctionId, p.PRD_SN AS productId, p.PRD_NM AS productName, seller.USR_NM AS sellerName, p.PRD_STATUS_CD AS productStatusCode, product_status.CMM_NM AS productStatusName, a.AUC_STATUS_CD AS auctionStatusCode, auction_status.CMM_NM AS auctionStatusName, COALESCE(bid.BID_COUNT, 0) AS bidCount, trade.TRD_SN AS tradeId, trade.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, trade_status.CMM_NM AS tradeStatusName, a.AUC_REG_DT AS registeredAt, cancel_request.AUC_CNL_REQ_SN AS cancelRequestId, cancel_request.AUC_CNL_REQ_RSN_CN AS cancelReason, cancel_request.AUC_CNL_REQ_REG_DT AS cancelRequestedAt, cancel_request.PREV_AUC_STATUS_CD AS previousAuctionStatusCode
ORDER BY CASE a.AUC_STATUS_CD WHEN 'AUCC0006' THEN 0 WHEN 'AUCC0002' THEN 1 WHEN 'AUCC0001' THEN 2 WHEN 'AUCC0003' THEN 3 WHEN 'AUCC0004' THEN 4 WHEN 'AUCC0005' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END ASC, CASE trade.TRD_STATUS_CD WHEN 'TRDC0003' THEN 0 WHEN 'TRDC0004' THEN 1 WHEN 'TRDC0005' THEN 2 WHEN 'TRDC0006' THEN 3 WHEN 'TRDC0007' THEN 4 WHEN 'TRDC0008' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END ASC, CASE WHEN a.AUC_STATUS_CD = 'AUCC0006' THEN cancel_request.AUC_CNL_REQ_REG_DT END DESC, a.AUC_REG_DT DESC, a.AUC_SN DESC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
